messages:
Maya: Quick update — all-hands in 22 min. Need to flip Roadmap and Q&A; leadership asked for the swap. Also Camera-B preview shows ~3s audio lag on my side. Can AV folks triage?

Liam: On it. Rerouting encoder to fallback host now.

Liam: /obs-switch --source cam-b --to fallback-encoder-02

AV-Bot: Encoder fallback completed on fallback-encoder-02, latency improved to ~350ms.

Sophia: Captions still delayed — OBS caption plugin shows 'stalled' in logs.

Ops: Restarting captioner service on studio-b.

Sophia: captions popped back after restart. testing snippet: "deployments will ship biweekly"

Carlos: Moving Roadmap after Q&A works for Product. @Jen ok with trimming roadmap time?

Jen: yes, go ahead. shorten leadership update to 5m, roadmap to follow but no animations.

Maya: Noted. Timeline: start in 15. @Eli pls be on standby for rollout questions.

Eli: I'll join. Also can someone create a clip of the Q&A for transcript team?

Liam: I'll start cloud recording and push to /recordings/allhands/2147500001.mp4

Maya: If audio lags again, fallback to phone mic with this command:

```bash
ssh ops@studio-b 'arecord -f cd -t wav | ffmpeg -i - -map 0:a -c:a aac -b:a 128k rtmp://live.redwood/infer/stream'
```

AV-Bot: Reminder: recordings retention set to 30d per policy.

Carlos: Slides: removing animations + swapping to PNGs to lower CPU.

Maya: Great. Everyone, please do a quick mic check in 10 and report anything odd here. :thumbsup: 

Jen: Leadership Q&A will be 10 min to make time for swapped items. thanks.

All: :thumbsup:
